name: Provider Reliability Telemetry
acceptance_criteria: captures success and failure outcomes without copying payloads or exception messages into observations
supports both asynchronous provider calls and synchronous Step 13 style enrichment providers
supports bounded failure classes and host-supplied result summaries
aggregates only one company and provider per reliability snapshot
deduplicates identical invocations and rejects conflicting invocation records
reports sample counts, rates, latency percentiles, freshness counts, and health state
provider health does not change decision eligibility, ranking, confidence, authorization, or routing

verification.note: Tests intentionally deferred until the broader archive integration pass is complete.
